EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yay!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} My team wins!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Try not to let it get you down.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} We
should play again soon!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Bien!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Gana mi equipo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Tampoco te deprimas, ¿eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡A ver
si volvemos a jugar a esto pronto!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Youhou !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu as perdu !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Je sais, c'est dur, mais ne te laisse
pas abattre.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu prendras ta
revanche un de ces jours !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Evviva!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ha vinto la mia squadra!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Non ci rimanere troppo male.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Giocheremo di nuovo, vedrai!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yaşasın!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Benim takım
kazandı!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Canını
sıkma.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Yakında
yine oynamalıyız!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Well, we've been training every day,
so there was really no way you were
going to beat us.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}But if you want revenge, we can try
again some other time!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}La verdad es que nos habíamos
entrenado muy duramente, así que
era muy difícil que nos ganaras.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Pero si quieres la revancha,
¡podemos repetir esto otro día!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Bah, on s'entraîne tous les jours.
On pouvait que gagner !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Cela dit, si cette écrasante défaite
te laisse un goût amer, on joue la
revanche quand tu veux !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Sai, ci siamo allenati tutti i giorni,
quindi era impossibile per te
batterci.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Se però vuoi una rivincita, possiamo
giocare di nuovo più avanti!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Her gün antrenman yaptığımız
için açıkçası bizi yenmen pek
mümkün değildi.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Ama rövanş
istiyorsan başka zaman
yine kapışırız!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:002A:}}All right!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Huge win for my team!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Heh heh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} You can try again one of
these days, but I'm pretty much
invincible! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:002A:}}¡Estupendo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Es una gran victoria
para mi equipo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Ja, ja!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Si quieres probamos otro
día de estos, ¡pero te aviso de que
soy casi invencible, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:002A:}}Parfait !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Et une victoire de plus
pour mon équipe, une !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hé hé !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Retente ta chance quand tu
voudras, mais le résultat risque
d'être identique,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:002A:}}Molto bene!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ha vinto la mia
squadra! Eccome!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Eh eh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Puoi riprovare uno di questi
giorni, ma ricordati che io sono
praticamente invincibile!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:002A:}}İşte bu!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Takımıma kocaman bir
zafer!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Heh heh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Bir gün yine
deneyebilirsin ama ben /
neredeyse yenilmezim! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
